home.whatToDo: What would you like to do?
home.pickText: First job, passport, scholarship… we’ll show what to get first.
home.docAlerts_one: 1 document in My Docs needs your attention
home.docAlerts_other: {{count}} documents in My Docs need your attention

guides.title: Guides
guides.intro: Fees, requirements and steps from official sources.
guides.firstJob: First job? Free once under RA 11261 with a First-Time Jobseeker Barangay Certification.
guides.officialSite: Official site · the only place to apply

ticket.fee: Fee to pay at the barangay
ticket.showAtCounter: Show this ticket and a valid ID at the counter.
ticket.qrSoon: Your QR claim code appears here when the request is approved.

showcase.title: Design system
showcase.intro: Every Phase 1 component in one place. Check it on a phone and a desktop browser.
showcase.sampleHint: As written on your valid ID

auth.signInIntro: Welcome back. Sign in to bring back your area, goals and settings.
auth.signUpIntro: An account keeps your area, goals and settings on any phone or browser. Guides and My Docs never need an account.
auth.fullNameHint: As written on your valid ID
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
auth.consentLabel: I agree to the privacy notice
auth.privacyText: Dokyu keeps your name, email, area and the documents you choose to track, only to run the app for you. We never sell or share them. Under the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) you can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.linkSent: If that email has a Dokyu account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. Please sign in with your new password.
auth.verifyDone: Your email is confirmed. Thank you!
auth.verifyFailed: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth.missingToken: This link is missing its code. Open the newest link from your email.
auth.noEmail: Password reset by email isn't switched on yet. Email {{email}} from your account's email address and we'll help you get back in.

onboarding.slide1Text: PSA, NBI, police clearance, passport and more. Students, workers, parents, seniors: Dokyu is for everyone who processes documents.
onboarding.slide2Text: Every requirement, photo size and fee before you leave home, so one trip to the office is enough.
onboarding.slide3Text: Register online through the official site, track your documents and get reminders. Then just submit and claim.
onboarding.areaIntro: Only your province and city are saved, never your exact location. This helps us show the nearest offices.
onboarding.municipalityHint: For example: Jolo, Pasig City, Zamboanga City
onboarding.noMatch: No province matches that. Check the spelling.
onboarding.goalsIntro: Pick any that apply. You can change these later.
onboarding.doneText: Create an account to save your progress, or start exploring the guides now.

account.guestText: Optional. An account keeps your area, goals, language and text size, so they come back on a new phone or browser. Guides and My Docs work without one.
account.unverified: Please confirm your email. We sent a link to {{email}}.
account.resent: A new link is on its way.

guide.noOnline: There is no online step for this document. Prepare everything below, then go to the office once.
guide.onlyIfTitle: Only if this applies to you
guide.unverified: Last checked {{date}}. Some details come from independent guides: confirm on the official site before you go.
guide.firstJob: First job? This is free once under RA 11261 with a First-Time Jobseeker Barangay Certification.
guide.whereBarangay: Go to your own barangay hall. Each barangay sets its own hours and fee.
guide.whereOnline: This one is done online; no office visit is listed yet.
guide.actionsHint: A checklist helps you pack. My Docs tracks your application and reminds you of dates.

checklist.title: Before you go
checklist.intro: Tick each item as you pack it. Saved on this device.
checklist.allSet: All set! You have everything for this trip.

checklists.title: My checklists
checklists.intro: Your “Before you go” lists, one per document. Tick items as you pack.
checklists.empty: Open any guide and tap the checklist button under “What to bring”. Your list shows up here so you can pack step by step.

tour.hello: Hi, I'm Doki! I'll help you get your papers in one trip. Let me show you around. It takes 20 seconds.
tour.services: Start here. Pick what you need, like an ID or a clearance, and I'll show you exactly what to bring.
tour.forYou: This card changes for you. It remembers your checklists and shows what to do next.
tour.ask: Stuck? Tap me anytime. I'll answer in English or Tagalog.
tour.guides: Every guide lives here: requirements, fees, and the official link to register online.
tour.done: That's it! Prepare at home, visit the office once. Let's go!
tour.replayHint: Doki's quick tour of the app

offices.title: Office Finder
offices.intro: Where to go, when it's open, and how to get there.
offices.locationDenied: Location is off, so offices are not sorted by distance. You can still pick an area.
offices.locationError: We couldn't get your location. Pick an area instead.
offices.locationPrivate: Your location stays on this phone. It is never saved or sent.
offices.none: No office in this area yet
offices.noneHint: Try another area. We're adding more offices.
offices.pinNote: Map pins are approximate. Use the landmark and Directions.
offices.mapOffline: The map needs internet. You can still use the addresses and the Directions button.
offices.hoursCheck: Usual government hours. Confirm before a long trip.
offices.policeText: You can get a National Police Clearance at any police station. Pick the one nearest you when you book on pnpclearance.ph.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.todayOff: Holiday today: {{name}}. Government offices are closed.
holidays.todayWeekend: It's the weekend. Most government offices are closed.
holidays.todayWorking: Today is a working day. Offices are open.

mydocs.intro: Keep track of papers for you and your family: what you have, what you're getting, and what's due.
mydocs.emptyText: Add a document to get reminders before appointments and expiry dates.
mydocs.familyHint: Track papers for your kids, parents and others
mydocs.familyIntro: Add the people whose papers you help with. Their names stay on this phone.
mydocs.privacy: My Docs is saved on this device only, even when you are signed in.
mydocs.reminderNote: On Android you'll get a reminder the day before, and 30 days before it expires.
mydocs.pickDocument: Pick a document, or choose Other.
mydocs.deleteText: It will be removed from My Docs along with its reminders.
mydocs.removeText: Their documents move to “Me” so nothing is lost.
mydocs.remindExpiryBody: {{name}} expires soon. Renew it before it does.

goals.title: Plan for a goal
goals.intro: Pick a goal. Doki lists what to get, in order, and what it costs in total.
goals.costNote: Fees are the cheapest option in each guide. First-time jobseekers get some of these free once.
goals.allTracked: All of these are in My Docs.

ask.hello: Hi! I'm Doki. Ask me what to bring, how much it costs, where to go, or what you need for a goal like your first job.
ask.subtitle: Answers from Dokyu's checked guides
ask.footer: Doki answers from Dokyu's guides on your phone. Always confirm on the official site.
ask.s1: What do I bring for NBI clearance?
ask.s3: Where do I get a PSA birth certificate?
ask.greeting: Hello! What document are you working on?
ask.thanks: You're welcome! Good luck with your papers.
ask.unknown: Sorry, I'm not sure about that yet. I know about PSA birth certificates, National ID, NBI and police clearance, barangay clearance, Postal ID, TIN and passports. Try asking about one of those.
ask.bringExtra_one: Plus {{count}} more thing if it applies to you.
ask.bringExtra_other: Plus {{count}} more things if they apply to you.
ask.ftjFree: First-time jobseeker? It can be free once.
ask.askMore: Ask me what to bring, the fees, or where to go.
ask.offices: I can show you offices near you, when they're open, and how to get there.

about.title: About & help
about.contactText: Email us. Tell us the guide or office and what changed.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Download everything Dokyu keeps about you, or delete it.
data.downloadFailed: We couldn't make the file. Please try again.
data.clearText: Your settings, checklists and My Docs on this phone will be erased. This cannot be undone.
data.deleteText: Your account and everything linked to it will be deleted from our server. This cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

preview.title: Accounts are coming soon
preview.text: This public preview has no server yet, so you can't sign in here. Everything else works without an account: guides, checklists, offices, holidays, My Docs and Ask Doki.
preview.account: Accounts are off on this preview. Everything else works without one.
